name: network-simulator
description: Web-based network simulation and learning platform with virtual Cisco-style routers and switches.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w engine && (npm run dev -w server & npm run dev -w web)
scripts.build: node scripts/build-info.mjs && npm run build -w engine && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w engine && npm run typecheck -w engine && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: npm run build -w engine && npm run test -w engine && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
